# crosswork_data_gateway_resource_configuration (Resource)

This resource can manage the memory and the state of the collectors of the Crosswork Data Gateways.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_data_gateway_resource_configuration" "example" {
  collectors = [
    {
      name    = "CLI"
      memory  = 9217
      enabled = true
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `collectors` (Attributes List) The collectors to manage, listed by name (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--collectors))
- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.
- `update_timeout` (Number) Seconds to wait for the controller to accept a change; it only limits how long Terraform waits and is not part of the Crosswork configuration
  - Range: `30`-`1800`
  - Default value: `120`

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

<a id="nestedatt--collectors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `collectors`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the collector
  - Choices: `CLI`, `GNMI`, `MDT`, `NETCONF`, `SNMP`, `SYSLOG`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the collector is enabled
- `memory` (Number) Memory of the collector in MB
  - Range: `500`-`153600`

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_data_gateway_resource_configuration.example "data_gateway_resource_configuration"
```
